name: cosmos-db
description: Multi-model NoSQL database with global distribution

roleAssignments.note: This is a Cosmos DB data-plane role, assigned via Cosmos DB RBAC (not ARM). Use sqlRoleAssignment resource, not standard roleAssignments.

integration.authNote: Use DefaultAzureCredential with Cosmos DB RBAC. No connection strings needed. Cosmos RBAC uses sqlRoleAssignment (not ARM role assignments).

sdkInitPattern.python:
from azure.cosmos.aio import CosmosClient
from azure.identity.aio import DefaultAzureCredential

credential = DefaultAzureCredential()
client = CosmosClient(url=os.environ['AZURE_COSMOS_ENDPOINT'], credential=credential)
db = client.get_database_client(os.environ['AZURE_COSMOS_DATABASE'])
container = db.get_container_client(os.environ['AZURE_COSMOS_CONTAINER'])

healthCheck.description: Validate connectivity by reading account metadata
